subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1251e2490f4715bb0096ca03cf09c0b954981b6bf0bd489efcf1b419418e6ca0.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Elements placed in the left diagonal, interchanged their positions and other elements shifted their position in an anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73867b30e0b9fc6301f29cb2035e672a0d815f18a978bf07a94018067089e132.png] 

2) The Elements placed in the outer square rotated their positions in a clockwise direction. The Elements placed in the inner square interchanged their positions.in 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f79482461cce13645d2f9bceba91ed85feeb197de55228f1d6b743589f9b4ef.png] 

These two unique methods follow alternatively.

3) As same as step 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e15b0b35bebd114a9982b90af78cfe07e530410cf6d5d23e8b986425c82d8315.png] 

4) As same as step 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06180bdd7f8444316a88524b19a9d4d61aaff3841661c9fa9ea0392ecc6cd8da.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
